title: Stinky Tofu
synopsis: Have you heard of stinky tofu before? It’s exactly what it sounds like …

fullText.simplified:
臭豆腐

    听说过或者吃过中国菜的人，大部分都觉得中国菜味道不错。但是有一种中国小吃，喜欢的人特别喜欢，讨厌的人听到这个菜的名字都会觉得不舒服——臭豆腐。
    看名字就知道，这个小吃是豆腐做的，味道闻起来很臭。但这只是它让人敬而远之的一个原因，它的样子也不太好看。大部分臭豆腐都是炸的，颜色黑黑的，这让不少人害怕。但总有人喜欢尝试未知，不少人在真的吃过臭豆腐以后，爱上了这个又丑又臭的小吃。不少爱吃臭豆腐的人都会说，臭豆腐闻起来臭，吃起来香。
    如果说食物也有性格，那么臭豆腐的性格就像生活里的一种人：看起来冷，但是变成朋友以后就是相反的性格，对你特别热情。你的身边有这样的朋友吗？如果在生活中遇到了臭豆腐这样的小吃，你愿不愿意试试呢？
fullText.traditional:
臭豆腐

    聽說過或者吃過中國菜的人，大部分都覺得中國菜味道不錯。但是有一種中國小吃，喜歡的人特別喜歡，討厭的人聽到這個菜的名字都會覺得不舒服——臭豆腐。
    看名字就知道，這個小吃是豆腐做的，味道聞起來很臭。但這只是它讓人敬而遠之的一個原因，它的樣子也不太好看。大部分臭豆腐都是炸的，顏色黑黑的，這讓不少人害怕。但總有人喜歡嘗試未知，不少人在真的吃過臭豆腐以後，愛上了這個又醜又臭的小吃。不少愛吃臭豆腐的人都會說，臭豆腐聞起來臭，吃起來香。
    如果說食物也有性格，那麼臭豆腐的性格就像生活裡的一種人：看起來冷，但是變成朋友以後就是相反的性格，對你特別熱情。你的身邊有這樣的朋友嗎？如果在生活中遇到了臭豆腐這樣的小吃，你願不願意試試呢？

sentences.simplified: 讨厌的人听到这个菜的名字都会觉得不舒服——臭豆腐。
sentences.traditional: 討厭的人聽到這個菜的名字都會覺得不舒服——臭豆腐。
sentences.pinyin: tǎo yàn de rén tīng dào zhè ge cài de míng zi dōu huì jué de bù shū fu chòu dòu fu
sentences.english: But there is one type of Chinese snack, people who like it really like it, ..
.. and people who loathe it feel sick when they hear its name – stinky tofu.

sentences.simplified: 看名字就知道，这个小吃是豆腐做的，味道闻起来很臭。
sentences.traditional: 看名字就知道，這個小吃是豆腐做的，味道聞起來很臭。
sentences.pinyin: kàn míng zi jiù zhī dào zhè ge xiǎo chī shì dòu fu zuò de wèi dào wén qǐ lái hěn chòu

sentences.simplified: 但这只是它让人敬而远之的一个原因，它的样子也不太好看。
sentences.traditional: 但這只是它讓人敬而遠之的一個原因，它的樣子也不太好看。

sentences.english: From looking at the name we know that this snack is made from tofu, and smells very stinky.

sentences.simplified: 大部分臭豆腐都是炸的，颜色黑黑的，这让不少人害怕。
sentences.traditional: 大部分臭豆腐都是炸的，顏色黑黑的，這讓不少人害怕。

sentences.english: But this is just one reason why it makes people keep a respectful distance. Its appearance is also not very attractive.

sentences.simplified: 但总有人喜欢尝试未知，
sentences.traditional: 但總有人喜歡嘗試未知，
sentences.pinyin: dàn zǒng yǒu rén xǐ huan cháng shì wèi zhī
sentences.english: Most stinky tofu is deep fried. It is blackish in color, which makes many people afraid.

sentences.simplified: 不少人在真的吃过臭豆腐以后，爱上了这个又丑又臭的小吃。
sentences.traditional: 不少人在真的吃過臭豆腐以後，愛上了這個又醜又臭的小吃。
sentences.pinyin: bù shǎo rén zài zhēn de chī guò chòu dòu fu yǐ hòu ài shàng le zhè ge yòu chǒu yòu chòu de xiǎo chī
sentences.english: But there are always people who like trying the unknown.

sentences.simplified: 不少爱吃臭豆腐的人都会说，臭豆腐闻起来臭，吃起来香。
sentences.traditional: 不少愛吃臭豆腐的人都會說，臭豆腐聞起來臭，吃起來香。
sentences.pinyin: bù shǎo ài chī chòu dòu fu de rén dōu huì shuō chòu dòu fu wén qi lai chòu chī qi lai xiāng
sentences.english: Many people who have really eaten stinky tofu before fall in love with this ugly and stinky snack.
Many people who love eating stinky tofu will say that stinky tofu smells stinky but tastes fragrant.

sentences.traditional: 那麼臭豆腐的性格就像生活裡的一種人：
sentences.pinyin: nà me chòu dòu fu de xìng gé jiù xiàng shēng huó lǐ de yì zhǒng rén
sentences.english: If we say that food can also have personalities, ..

sentences.simplified: 看起来冷，但是变成朋友以后就是相反的性格，
sentences.traditional: 看起來冷，但是變成朋友以後就是相反的性格，
sentences.pinyin: kàn qi lai lěng dàn shì biàn chéng péng you yǐ hòu jiù shì xiāng fǎn de xìng gé
sentences.english: .. then stinky tofu would have a personality that resembles this type of person in life:

sentences.english: Those who look cold, but after becoming friends show the opposite personality, ..

sentences.traditional: 你的身邊有這樣的朋友嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ de shēn biān yǒu zhè yàng de péng you ma
sentences.english: .. and are particularly warm-hearted towards you.

sentences.simplified: 如果在生活中遇到了臭豆腐这样的小吃，你愿不愿意试试呢？
sentences.traditional: 如果在生活中遇到了臭豆腐這樣的小吃，你願不願意試試呢？
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zài shēng huó zhōng yù dào le chòu dòu fu zhè yàng de xiǎo chī nǐ yuàn bú yuàn yì shì shi ne
sentences.english: Do you have these kinds of friends around you?
If in your daily life you encounter stinky tofu, would you be willing to give it a try?

raw.synopsis: Have you heard of stinky tofu before? It’s exactly what it sounds like …
sentence_translations: Most people who have heard of or eaten Chinese cuisine before think that it tastes pretty good.
But there is one type of Chinese snack, people who like it really like it, ..
.. and people who loathe it feel sick when they hear its name – stinky tofu.
From looking at the name we know that this snack is made from tofu, and smells very stinky.
But this is just one reason why it makes people keep a respectful distance. Its appearance is also not very attractive.
Most stinky tofu is deep fried. It is blackish in color, which makes many people afraid.
But there are always people who like trying the unknown.
Many people who have really eaten stinky tofu before fall in love with this ugly and stinky snack.
Many people who love eating stinky tofu will say that stinky tofu smells stinky but tastes fragrant.
If we say that food can also have personalities, ..
.. then stinky tofu would have a personality that resembles this type of person in life:
Those who look cold, but after becoming friends show the opposite personality, ..
.. and are particularly warm-hearted towards you.
Do you have these kinds of friends around you?
If in your daily life you encounter stinky tofu, would you be willing to give it a try?
